name: smwmusic-deltarune-black-knife
title: Deltarune - Black Knife
description:
The song "Black Knife" from Chapter 3 of Deltarune, which plays against the chapter's final boss, originally composed by Toby Fox. Good for tough boss fights, or just really tense moments.

The original samples were found using stormstudios1's Deltarune Sample Sheet.
